pnc_code.description: Classic Nissan FAST 5-digit PNC, or PartSouq alphanumeric code-on-image (e.g. C8320, 16132PA).

catalog_section_path.description: Human breadcrumb path, e.g. FUEL & ENGINE CONTROL > INJECTOR (shop-by-diagram navigation).
